## Names

<a id="protection_result"></a>
### [`protection_result`](../../../src/room_enemy_tables.asm#L7) `$1166`

*variable*

Result of a protection check: spawn_yamo stores prot_key_yamo XOR prot_key_yamo_pair here when Yamo appears. actor_play_step_sound starts damaging code when it is 0. Start value $FF.

- **Read by:** [`actor_play_step_sound`](actor_step.md#actor_play_step_sound) [`$1FCE`](../../../src/actor_step.asm#L572)
- **Written by:** [`spawn_yamo`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_yamo) [`$0CDE`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L211)

<a id="contact_mask_addr_lo"></a>
### [`contact_mask_addr_lo`](../../../src/room_enemy_tables.asm#L15) `$1167-$1238`

*data*

Low bytes of the 210 destination addresses of the background contact masks of the actor frames that build_contact_masks makes at cold start (high bytes in contact_mask_addr_hi, same index = frame number). Each mask is 96 bytes: three columns of 32 rows at +$00, +$20 and +$40. Entries are pairs: even index = the mask of a pose at $9000-$9FBF (over the room charset sources, which are expanded by then) or $C000-$CADF; odd index = the second sprite of the pose, expanded into the scratch block shift_mask_col0 ($CAE0) and ORed into the mask before it, or high byte 0 when there is no second sprite (the Ninja).

- **Referred to by:** [`expand_contact_mask`](frame_builder.md#expand_contact_mask) [`$5193`](../../../src/frame_builder.asm#L103)

<a id="contact_mask_addr_hi"></a>
### [`contact_mask_addr_hi`](../../../src/room_enemy_tables.asm#L44) `$1239-$130A`

*data*

High bytes of the contact mask addresses (see contact_mask_addr_lo). 0 = no second sprite.

- **Referred to by:** [`expand_contact_mask`](frame_builder.md#expand_contact_mask) [`$518E`](../../../src/frame_builder.asm#L101)

<a id="ninja_room_delay"></a>
### [`ninja_room_delay`](../../../src/room_enemy_tables.asm#L75) `$130B-$131E`

*data*

Per room (20 bytes, index = room): main loop passes (3 frames each) before the Ninja first appears after Bruce enters the room. draw_room copies it to ninja_spawn_timer. The 0 entries are rooms with room_no_enemies set.

- **Referred to by:** [`draw_room`](draw_room.md#draw_room) [`$0A4E`](../../../src/draw_room.asm#L102)

<a id="ninja_respawn_delay"></a>
### [`ninja_respawn_delay`](../../../src/room_enemy_tables.asm#L81) `$131F-$1332`

*data*

Per room (20 bytes): main loop passes before the Ninja appears again; update_ninja_spawn and reset_spawn_timer copy it to ninja_spawn_timer.

- **Referred to by:** [`reset_yamo_spawn_timer`](actor_spawn.md#reset_yamo_spawn_timer) [`$0D76`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L312), [`reset_yamo_spawn_timer`](actor_spawn.md#reset_yamo_spawn_timer) [`$0D7E`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L316), [`update_ninja_spawn`](actor_spawn.md#update_ninja_spawn) [`$0DE4`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L383)

<a id="ninja_spawn_side"></a>
### [`ninja_spawn_side`](../../../src/room_enemy_tables.asm#L87) `$1333-$1346`

*data*

Per room (20 bytes): start point of the Ninja. spawn_actor uses this byte only for the zero test (0 = random of the two start points); the side itself comes from yamo_spawn_side (see spawn_actor).

- **Referred to by:** [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor) [`$0C2C`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L105)

*data*

<a id="yamo_spawn_side"></a>
### [`yamo_spawn_side`](../../../src/room_enemy_tables.asm#L107) `$136F-$1382`

*data*

Per room (20 bytes): start point of Yamo (and of the Ninja, see spawn_actor). 0 = random of the two start points; else 3 times in 4 the point given by bit 7 (clear = start point A spawn_a_x/y, set = start point B spawn_b_x/y) and 1 time in 4 random.

- **Referred to by:** [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor) [`$0C04`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L84), [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor) [`$0C10`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L89), [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor) [`$0C38`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L110)

<a id="joystick_right_handed"></a>
### [`joystick_right_handed`](../../../src/room_enemy_tables.asm#L114) `$1383-$1384`

*variable*

Handedness of joystick 1 (+0) and joystick 2 (+1), index = port - 1. 1 = right handed (normal), 0 = left handed: frame_update turns the directions 90 degrees and the status line shows an L. Set on the title with L, shift-L (left) and R, shift-R (right). Start value 1.

- **Read by:** [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$15EE`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L60), [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$1606`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L76) (+1)
- **Written by:** [`title_menu_handedness_keys`](title_menu.md#title_menu_handedness_keys) [`$0974`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L123), [`title_menu_handedness_keys`](title_menu.md#title_menu_handedness_keys) [`$0983`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L131) (+1), [`title_menu_handedness_keys`](title_menu.md#title_menu_handedness_keys) [`$0993`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L139), [`title_menu_handedness_keys`](title_menu.md#title_menu_handedness_keys) [`$09A3`](../../../src/title_menu.asm#L147) (+1)
- **Referred to by:** [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$16AE`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L188), [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$16E5`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L225)

<a id="title_music_off"></a>
### [`title_music_off`](../../../src/room_enemy_tables.asm#L118) `$1385`

*variable*

0 = the title screen plays its music (on the first title and then every fifth time, see title_music_skip_count); 1 = silent. The S key toggles it during a game.
